en.headline: More dengue in Air Itam this week
body: Keep pots and pails at home dry today.
Mosquitoes lay eggs in still water.
Put on insect cream in the daytime.
See a doctor early if you get a fever.
Tell the doctor about all your tablets.
en.passage: Empty and scrub containers, flower pot plates and pails at home at least once a week.

ms.headline: Lebih banyak denggi di Air Itam minggu ini
body: Buang air dalam pasu dan baldi hari ini.
Sapu losyen nyamuk pada waktu siang.
Jumpa doktor awal jika anda demam.
Beritahu doktor tentang semua ubat anda.
ms.passage: Empty and scrub containers, flower pot plates and pails at home at least once a week.

zh.headline: 亚依淡本周骨痛热症病例增加
body: 今天就倒掉花盆和水桶里的积水。
蚊子在不流动的水里产卵。
发烧的话，早点去看医生。
告诉医生您吃的所有药。
zh.passage: Empty and scrub containers, flower pot plates and pails at home at least once a week.
